# demo-api
![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.2.0-blue) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

API REST de demostración con Express
## Tech stack

- **Runtime:** Node.js
- **Language:** JavaScript (2 files)
- **Frameworks:** Express, Vitest
- **Key dependencies:** express, zod
- **Dev dependencies:** vitest

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18 or later
- npm, yarn, or pnpm

## Installation

```bash
npm install
```

## Usage

```bash
npm run start
```

### Entry points

- `src/index.js` (main)
